style.styleTitle: Lights4fun Oversized 2m Pre Lit Christmas Frosted Berry and Pinecone Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Make this festive season merry and bright with our pre lit frosted berry Christmas garland. At 2m in length, this luxurious wreath is an oversized version of our best selling frosted berry garland so you can decorate larger space with this elegant and timeless decoration.</p><p>Featuring pine, eucalyptus and berry faux foliage, the garland is made with a natural twig frame to create a full and sturdy Christmas staple. Pre lit with 50 warm white LEDs, style your garland on staircases, across your mantelpiece or as part of your dining display to add a cosy Christmas glow to your home.</p><p>To use, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box and choose the optional 6 hour timer function for an automatic seasonal sparkle night after night.</p>
